t: When the thought of the Fire frightens you
a: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا إِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
p: Rabbana-ṣrif ʿannā ʿadhāba jahannam, inna ʿadhābahā kāna gharāmā.
m: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering; Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
